reviewer.scope: Independent design, code, retained-test and final evidence audit. Runtime suites were not rerun by the auditor; four read-only record verifiers and direct source/artifact hash checks were run.

resolved: Enter activation is visible in the current-folder filter placeholder.
The active tab exposes its accessible name through the GtkButton child label; actual AT-SPI proof and a failing old-binary control were reviewed.
The cut-completion fixture allocates and frees the new UI extension; old-fixture SIGSEGV and final-fixture success were demonstrated against the same native source.
The private D-Bus fixture isolates XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; the helper pins the current accessibility bus, clears stale child overrides and rejects unsupported client-bus switching.

code.assertion_change_scope: Only default window geometry changed from 800x600 to 1000x700.
code.transfer_scope: Dialogs own copied source pathname strings and directory strings. The operation engine establishes filesystem identities after acceptance; no dialog-open file-ID pinning is claimed.

evidence.candidate_scope: Ten publication files matched at review time. This historical candidate includes the pre-approval advanced review; review JSON files are excluded from sources to avoid cycles.

windows.github_api_confirmation: completed/success; push on main at reviewed code commit

desktop.image_scope: Published image is an actual application GUI-test screenshot. The separate actual desktop screenshot was also visually inspected; the auditor did not control the desktop.

evidence.visual_review: Reviewed final hierarchy, command placement, disabled-selection state, filter cue, active tab, left navigation, useful file area and bounded long-path/confirmation evidence. No layout blocker was found.
evidence.readme_review: Dependency/local-artifact limitations are explicit. The final documentation-only Xvfb width correction matches the already-tested check.sh commands and does not change executable sources.

limits: Windows Security-page visual Cancel and ACL Apply remain unverified.
Third-party Shell extensions, broader Windows Properties interaction, external Windows Explorer transfer and packaging remain unverified.
Physical FAT/exFAT/ReFS and network-volume support is not established by injected provider controls; native Undo identity stamps support local NTFS only.
Path revalidation does not eliminate every external-writer race. Session Undo remains conservative and identity-provider dependent.

Historical receipts are editable evidence records, not cryptographic execution attestations. GUI receipt verification requires the retained local binary, logs and screenshots; fresh checkouts must regenerate them.
Final metadata-only publication, remote transport verification and ledger calibration are coordinator steps following this approval.
coordinator_followup_authorized: Set the advanced review to accepted-for-delivery and clear completed delivery items.
Refresh evidence metadata hashes and unchanged-denominator progress ledgers; calibrate the gates and run their meters.
Commit and push only the reviewed metadata/evidence scope, then verify the final remote transport.
